title: Jeffrey Epstein VI Foundation
content: The Jeffrey Epstein VI Foundation was a private foundation established in 2000 by New York convicted sex offender and disgraced financier Jeffrey Epstein. The foundation sometimes went by the name Enhanced Education, but was officially registered as J. Epstein VI Foundation. The "VI" stood for Virgin Islands, as the foundation was based on the Epstein-owned Little Saint James within the archipelago.
